title: One line of data/seed/<poolId>/venues.jsonl (public places with simulated booking inventory)
description: Public places only. Real public places (parks, museums, well-known venues) may use their real names; booking, prices and inventory are always simulated and shown as 'Simulated booking'. Never imply a partnership.

kind.description: park, cafe, game_cafe, climbing_gym, studio, museum, bar, library, trail, beach, community_center, ...

photo.description: Path relative to the pool folder, e.g. 'venue_photos/vn_lands_end.jpg'. Licensed or generated; listed in venue_photos/PROVENANCE.md.

hours.description: Local opening hours. Absent = always open (parks, trails).

capacityPerSlot.description: Simulated inventory: people per time slot.

payAtVenueAllowed.description: Muse's in-bounds fallback when someone declines a prepaid approval.

failureRate.description: Simulated booking failure probability outside demo controls. Default 0.

sensitive.description: Place whose visits imply a sensitive category (place of worship, clinic). Never used for plans; exists so connector records can reference it.
